items.description: San Fernando is a municipality in the Nueva Segovia department, set in the mountains near the Honduran border.
El Jicaro is a town in the Nueva Segovia department, known for its mining and agriculture.
Desembocadura de Rio Grande is a town in the South Caribbean Coast Autonomous Region, located at the river's mouth.
Corn Island is a major tourism destination and municipality in the South Caribbean Coast Autonomous Region.
La Cruz de Rio Grande is a town in the South Caribbean Coast Autonomous Region, accessible primarily by river.
Morrito is a municipality in the Rio San Juan department, situated on the banks of Lake Nicaragua.
San Jorge is a port town in the Rivas department, serving as a primary transit point for Ometepe Island.
Belen is a municipality in the Rivas department, situated in the fertile southwestern plains.
Potosi is a town in the Rivas department, known for its sugar cane production and colonial history.
Buenos Aires is a small municipality in the Rivas department, located on the western shore of Lake Nicaragua.
Cardenas is a border town in the Rivas department, located near the border with Costa Rica.
San Juan de Rio Coco is a mountain town in the Madriz department, famous for high-quality coffee.
